authority_boundary.downstream_responsibility: pricing, risk, scenario, policy-sensitivity and model consequences

market_model_boundary.principle: physical quantity and market price are separate analytical processes
market_model_boundary.physical_quantity: SPK consumes an explicitly admitted Policy Lab quantity and never derives market price from that quantity implicitly
market_model_boundary.negative_price_support: Bachelier and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck surfaces permit negative market prices; Black-76 explicitly rejects non-positive forwards

policy_sensitivity.principle: governance policy is an explicit analytical dimension, never a hidden default
policy_sensitivity.blocked_outcomes: retained for comparison but never priced
policy_sensitivity.multi_policy_pricing: all admitted policies can be valued under one common market/model assumption set

non_claims: SPK Derivatives is not a policy authority.
SPK Derivatives does not upgrade Policy Lab evidence assurance.
Policy sensitivity is not the same thing as market sensitivity or evidence truth.
Model output is not settlement, legal, regulatory, liquidity, or execution authority.
Ornstein-Uhlenbeck scenarios are not automatically a risk-neutral pricing measure.
Deterministic contract settlement arithmetic is not legal settlement authority or trade execution.
The repository remains research/beta software rather than a production trading system.
